body.zh: 采样与 Chamber State 不一致
边界：不同产品会给CTQ 不同权重；最优平台来自可重复的工艺输出，而不是反应器名称。
body.en: Boundary: different products assign different weights to CTQ; the best platform comes from repeatable process output rather than the reactor name.

notes.zh: 电性可靠性第四小图标题原图字形为“湿湿偏置”（疑似来源错字），忠实保留，英文按湿度偏置试验语义译出；未替来源改为确定的试验名称。
notes.en: The fourth electrical/reliability mini-chart appears to say “湿湿偏置,” possibly a source typo. It is retained; the English conveys humidity-bias testing without asserting a corrected test name.
